={{ JSON.stringify({
  chat_link_key: String($json.chat_link_key ?? ''),

    String($json.message_id ?? '') +
    ':' +

  target_room: 'Pg_Chat⭐BINARY_xXx_STAR',

  recipient_name: $json.recipient_name ?? undefined,
  customer_name: $json.customer_name ?? undefined
}) }}
